name: Vedran Vulicevic
reason: Too thin: beyond the Kripalu programme he co-presents as one of four teachers on Deborah King's LifeForce weekend (22-24 Jan 2027), his site offers only two 40-minute sessions (distance energy healing and spiritual counselling, which make one item), with no books, no free resources and one 2020 YouTube meditation on a one-subscriber channel that is framed around overcoming stress and anxiety (left out under the health rule); checked 1 Nov 2026.
